audience: PROOF CHECK · ONE JOB, LINE BY LINE
hook_say: Say you quote $355 to soft wash a 2-story house. Here is where every dollar goes, line by line.

rows.label: 3 hrs on site (at $64.89 an hour)
rows.say: Three hours on site, with your pay, tax and overhead: $194.67
rows.why: 3 hours at the example's break-even rate of $64.89 an hour, which holds your pay, self-employment tax and monthly overhead (insurance, phone, ads). Trip costs and supplies are separate lines.

rows.label: 40 min of driving, same rate
rows.why: A 20-mile round trip at 30 mph is 40 minutes of your time, priced at the same break-even rate.

rows.label: Van, 20 miles
rows.why: 20 miles at $0.76 a mile in the example.

rows.label: Soap and supplies
rows.why: The example's supplies for a 2-story soft wash.

rows.label: Break-even for this job
rows.why: Everything above added up. Charge less and the job pays you less than your goal.

fix.label: Profit left at a $355 quote
fix.why: $355 minus $298.13. Your pay is already inside the break-even, so this is profit on top.
